verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair question for an identity and directory platform that stores user and event-log data, so the axis applies. The pack only shows adjacent capabilities: exporting directory event data, aggregating logs, and identity termination and offboarding. None of these documents configurable retention periods or data-deletion controls, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
